replacement_lines: var sample = new Simulation.Telemetry.VehicleTelemetry { VehicleId = request.VehicleId, SpeedKph = (float)(request.Speed * 3.6) };
var fields = new Dictionary<string, object> { ["vehicle_id"] = entity.VehicleId, ["speed_kph"] = entity.SpeedKph };
return new { fields, speeding = entity.SpeedKph > 108.0, constructed_payload = Convert.ToBase64String(sample.ToByteArray()) };

rationale: Renamed SpeedMps to SpeedKph across all usages per schema change. Converted input request.Speed (meters per second) to kilometers per hour by multiplying by 3.6 before assigning to SpeedKph. Updated threshold from 30.0 m/s to 108.0 kph (equivalent). Changed dictionary key from speed_mps to speed_kph for runtime observation key. All changes preserve VehicleId and speeding decisions on adopted cases.
assumptions: Generated protobuf class property is now SpeedKph (was SpeedMps).
Input request.Speed remains in meters per second per intended_behavior.
Wire format field 2 stays float32; conversion is applied before serialization.
Coordinated rollout only; mixed versions not handled.

candidate_reviews.reason: Assignment to SpeedMps must become SpeedKph with mps->kph conversion factor 3.6.
Dictionary key speed_mps becomes speed_kph; member access entity.SpeedMps becomes entity.SpeedKph.
Speeding threshold uses SpeedMps > 30.0; must become SpeedKph > 108.0.
